checks.name_order: TopoOrderRC at llvmorg-20.1.8 (CodeGenRegisters.cpp:973-994) orders by RSI, then descending member count, then StringRef(name) <. That is a byte-wise lexicographic comparison where a prefix sorts first, so 'GPR' < 'GPRAV2' < 'GPRAV4' < 'GPRF32' ('A' 0x41 < 'F' 0x46). The regenerated IDs confirm it: GPR 7, GPRAV2 8, GPRAV4 9, GPRF32 10. Before the fix they were GPR 7, GPRF32 8, PulpV2 9, PulpV4 10.
checks.regenerated_register_info: Regenerated RISCVGenRegisterInfo.inc three times: HEAD with build/20-T007 llvm-tblgen (byte-identical to the build's own .inc), integration head 1a4b5a586bfe, and port/19 (9b2edaf923ad) with build/int-19 llvm-tblgen. port/19: the GPR, PulpV2 and PulpV4 SubClassMasks are identical (0x03fbbff8,...), and each class lists the other two as superclasses. Integration head: PulpV2/PulpV4 mask 0x7f6bf600 lacks GPR bit 7 (GPR mask is 0x7f6bf680), and GPRSuperclasses has only GPRAll. HEAD: GPR, GPRAV2 and GPRAV4 masks are identical (0x7f6bf380, bits 7/8/9 set). GPR's superclasses are GPRAV2, GPRAV4 and GPRAll. GPRAV2's are GPR, GPRAV4 and GPRAll, and GPRAV4's are GPR, GPRAV2 and GPRAll. I compared every class's superclass list between integration head and HEAD after applying the rename. The only difference is GPRSuperclasses gaining GPRAV2 and GPRAV4, which is exactly the port/19 relation. GPRF16/GPRF32 no longer being in the clique is upstream's intended change and is untouched.
